category_edits.rationale: Test a stronger causal interest contribution: 0.75*h_t+0.25*m_t with the existing three-interaction half-life across all four datasets. The weaker 15% pooling configuration regressed. Preserve padding exclusion, causal histories, final-real-position inference, GRU topology, embeddings, scoring, loss and optimizer.

change_summary: Increase causal pooling weight from 20% to 25%, retain half-life 3, and synchronize checkpoint metadata and the embedded predictor validation. Retain one GRU4Rec model per dataset.
